tools.name: list_coverage
tools.description: List covered US cities and counties (ids, names, permit counts, newest permit date, and how often their records include zip, location, job value, contractor and phone), permit categories and prices. Free.

tools.name: sample_permits
tools.description: Three real permit records from 30-60 days ago for one area (optionally one category), to see the data before paying. Free.

tools.name: permit_stats
tools.description: Count building permits issued in the last N days (1-90) by category, for one area or all. Free.

tools.name: permit_trends
tools.description: Daily permit counts and the busiest cities and zip codes for one category over the last N days. Free.

tools.name: count_permits
tools.description: How many permits match a search (area, category, city, zip, distance, multi-trade projects, dates, minimum value) before paying for the records. Free.

tools.name: search_permits
tools.description: Newly issued building permits with address, permit type, description, contractor, job value and issue date, filtered by area, category, city, zip, distance from a point or zip, multi-trade projects, dates and minimum value, newest first or sorted by job value or urgency. Up to 100 per call. Costs $0

tools.name: permit_history_for_address
tools.description: Every known building permit at a street address in any covered area. Costs $0.05 in USDC (x402; Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum); no charge when nothing matches.

tools.name: weekly_permit_report
tools.description: All building permits issued in the last 7 days for one area, with counts by category. Costs $1.00 in USDC (x402; Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum); no charge when nothing matches.

tools.name: top_contractors
tools.description: The busiest contractors in one area over the last 7-90 days, optionally for one permit type: permit counts, total declared job value, mix of work, busiest zip codes and business phone where the city publishes it.
